title: The Crown-Lamp of Elden Root
summary: From the Thalmor Crown Court in the upper boughs of Elden Root to the root-slums below and the port of Haven, tree-shapers track a syndicate draining sap-light from the Great Oak's Crown-Lamp.

hook.rumour: The great amber Crown-Lamp suspended in the upper boughs of Elden Root dimmed three nights running, and root-wardens found glass siphon-tubes hidden in the lower heartwood.
hook.notice: ELDEN ROOT TEMPLE & CROWN COURT: Wardens needed to trace the heartwood sap-siphons between Elden Root, Cormount, and the port of Haven.

npcs.name: Warden of Elden Root
npcs.greet: The great amber Crown-Lamp suspended in the upper boughs of Elden Root dimmed three nights running, and root-wardens found glass siphon-tubes hidden in the lower heartwood.
talk: The trouble across Grahtwood began when sealed dispatches started bypassing Elden Root.
If you mean to help the Great Oak Court of Elden Root, start by checking the trail between Elden Root and Elden Tree.

npcs.name: Chronicler of Elden Root
npcs.greet: Keep your voice low—everyone at Elden Tree is watching who asks after the old seals.
talk: We traced the couriers from Elden Tree toward Elden Hollow before they vanished into the brush.
Bring any ciphered tallies back to Elden Root so Camoran Tree-ThaneFaraniel can see the proof.

npcs.name: Outrider of Elden Hollow
npcs.greet: You made good time from Elden Tree. The saboteurs have fortified the approaches near The Orrery.
talk: Their ringleader is holding the inner chamber at The Orrery with a picked guard.
Once The Orrery is cleared, return to Elden Root to seal the regional compact.

npcs.name: Speaker of Elden Root
npcs.greet: Camoran Tree-ThaneFaraniel awaits word on whether the crisis in Grahtwood has been contained.
talk: The elders of Elden Root have prepared the concord table for your return.
All of Grahtwood owes you a debt for standing between Elden Root and ruin.

Chronicler of Elden Root: The seal impressions cite the old charters of the Great Oak Court of Elden Root word for word.
Outrider of Elden Hollow: Our scouts spotted lantern-signals flashing between Elden Root and The Orrery at dusk.
